candidates.title: AsymFlow: Enabling Long-Context LLM Serving via CPU-GPU Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
candidates.reason: Recent CPU-GPU prefill/decode disaggregated LLM serving system with shared-memory KV streaming and AMX decode; directly relevant to hierarchical memory, KV offload, and heterogeneous serving.

candidates.title: CrossServe: Cross-Layer Scheduling for SLO Optimization in Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Recent multi-tenant LLM serving scheduler jointly optimizing routing, adaptive micro-batching and weighted preemption with strong SLO gains on 32 GPUs.

candidates.title: WAQ-LLM: Optimizing Multi-Instance LLM Deployment via Workload-Aware Queueing Model
candidates.reason: Recent analytical deployment optimizer for aggregated/disaggregated multi-instance LLM serving; directly relevant to scheduling, disaggregation and SLO-aware configuration.

candidates.title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
candidates.reason: Recent long-context inference method with GPU-side conditional global-attention execution in vLLM, directly relevant to sparse attention and KV-access reduction.

candidates.title: Cross-Layer Performance Analysis of Single-GPU Large Language Model Inference
candidates.reason: Recent systems study jointly profiling model, runtime, operator and GPU layers with dynamic KV-cache characterization; useful for identifying inference bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.
